subject: Consolidating QBR + Roadmap demo — alternative shift & workshop pairing
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@zenithhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Sep 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + roadmap demo — request to compress and include expansion ask

Hi Karthik,

Hope you had a great weekend. As we prep for our renewal conversation, the execs at Zenith asked whether we can fold the roadmap-focused demo and the QBR into two tightly scheduled sessions instead of the three we discussed. They'd like one compact executive walkthrough (60–75min) focusing on the ROI items and a hands-on technical workshop (90min) for the infra and SRE teams.

Key constraints: the execs are only available on 9/24 (afternoon PT) and 9/25 (morning PT). Our infra folks in Chicago have strong preference for 9/25 after 11:00 CT. They also requested a single point-of-contact for procurement redlines.

Can Redwood accommodate a split like this? If so, please share an MOA (mutual action plan) and available hosts. I attached our prework (zenith_qbr-prework.pdf).

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Nguyen
Director, Platform Strategy | Zenith Health

Attachment: zenith_qbr-prework.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Sep 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — request to compress and include expansion ask

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the clear constraints and the prework. We can absolutely do two sessions:
- Exec walkthrough: 60–75min (value metrics + roadmap highlights + top-line migration options)
- Technical workshop: 90min (deep dive on routing/fallbacks, batching, and private deployment checklist)

Proposed slots from our side that respect your windows:
- Exec: 2029-09-24 14:00–15:15 PT (we can tighten to 60min if execs prefer)
- Tech workshop: 2029-09-25 11:30–13:00 CT (that maps to 9/25 09:30–11:00 PT) — fits the infra preference for after 11:00 CT if we run CT local 11:30 start.

A couple of asks to make the sessions high value:
1) Can Zenith share two prioritized use cases (short bullets) for the exec deck?
2) For the workshop, we need 2–3 technical attendees who can approve model-hosting decisions (SRE, Cloud Eng).
3) Procurement: please send the primary contact so Lauren can coordinate DocuSign/term redlines.

I attached an updated mutual action plan skeleton (mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx) and will hold the slots tentatively until I hear back.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0118

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: Wed, 18 Sep 2029 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — request to compress and include expansion ask

Karthik —

Thanks, those slots look promising. Quick clarifications:
- Exec priority bullets: (1) cost reduction for inference (~3–6 months), (2) latency guarantees for core patient-facing workflows, (3) data isolation options for PHI.
- Technical attendees: I will confirm SRE (Jamal Park) and Cloud Eng (Asha Rao) by EOD today.
- Procurement POC: Meredith Price (meredith.price@zenithhealth.com). She will handle contract redlines.

Please go ahead and tentatively book both slots. Also, can Lauren pick up procurement threads? Meredith prefers a single point for DocuSign and a redline summary.

Claire

Thanks — Meredith, I’ll take procurement lead and will consolidate redlines into one document for faster review. Please expect a DocuSign envelope and a redline summary by Friday (9/20).

Operational notes from my side:
- Exec session: Karthik and I will co-host; recommend having Meredith (procurement) join the last 10 minutes so she hears the commercial ask live.
- Tech workshop: Monica will lead the ops portion; Karthik will cover runtime/architecture. We recommend providing a single test prompt set (10–12 prompts) ahead of time so Monica can pre-configure the sandbox instance.

I’ll send calendar invites now with tentative holds. If the execs want a shorter exec session, we can compress and shift 15min onto the tech workshop.
